entries.title: Ask HN: Why the Microsoft hate?
entries.author: seanmcdirmid
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Why the Microsoft hate?
entries.excerpt: When new the Nokia tablet was announced yesterday, submissions made it to the front page but were promptly flagged off by many saying "this wasn't relevant to HN;" regardless of all the excitement over the new iPad. So is HN basically becoming Slashdot where Microsoft hate occurs by default? entries.title: Why we revert to original titles
entries.author: pg
entries.current_title: Why we revert to original titles
entries.excerpt: In the HN guidelines, we ask submitters to use original titles when possible. When they don't, we often change the title of a post back to the original title of the article. There is an ongoing trickle of complaints about this, as if we were engaged in some sort of sinister conspiracy. Titles on HN are not self-expression the way comments are. Titles are common property. entries.guide_zh: HN 解释为何常把投稿标题改回原题，回应编辑行为带来的疑问。
